name: Grenadine essence
description: A high-proof grenadine flavoring reconstructed from a 1900s soda-fountain formula. Used by the drop to flavor and color drinks in place of modern pomegranate grenadine.
instructions: Combine 3 drops clove oil, 9 drops sweet orange oil, 2.5 ml vanilla extract, 2 ml ginger extract (or 1 ml fresh pressed ginger juice), 30 ml maraschino liqueur, 1 ml cochineal tincture, 60 ml distilled water, 8 ml acid phosphate, and 137 ml Everclear.
